meta.status: PARTIALLY VERIFIED. Rates change; re-check every line before relying on it. DEFAULT config: brokerage Rs 0 (see notes).
sources: exchange_txn_pct 0.00307 = Rs 306.99 transaction charge + Rs 0.01 IPFT contribution per crore, each side, effective 2026-03-01. PRIMARY: NSE circular NSE/FA/73061 dated 2026-02-27 (https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FA73061.pdf), fetched 2026-10-28, table text decoded from the PDF.

stt_buy_pct / stt_sell_pct 0.1 = delivery equity, purchaser and seller, 'No Change' from 2026-04-01. PRIMARY: NSE circular NSE/FATAX/73524 dated 2026-03-31 (https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FATAX73524.pdf), fetched 2026-10-28.

sebi_pct 0.0001 = 0.00010 per cent of turnover (Rs 10 per crore), cash segment. PRIMARY: SEBI Gazette notification dated 2019-03-22 as hosted in NSE circular NSE/FA/40632 (https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FA40632.pdf). NOT checked whether a later notification changed it.

stamp_buy_pct 0.015 = uniform stamp duty on delivery equity, buyer only, from 2020-07-01. SECONDARY ONLY (Zerodha and Upstox announcements); the Indian Stamp Act / Finance Act 2019 notification was not retrieved.
gst_pct 18 = GST on (brokerage + exchange charges + SEBI fee). UNVERIFIED in this session (not fetched).

brokerage: default Rs 0 per fill, chosen by the project owner because many discount brokers charge nothing on equity delivery. This is an ASSUMPTION about the broker, not a verified rate; brokerage is broker-specific (full-service brokers charge a percentage). For a more conservative flat charge use configs/costs_nse_delivery_flat20.json (Rs 20 per executed fill).
meta.notes: THIS FILE IS THE DEFAULT (equals CostConfig::nse_delivery_defaults()). Not modelled: DP (depository) charges on sells, delivery-shorting costs, annual/AMC fees, exchange-specific category differences, taxes on gains (STCG/LTCG).
